decisions.reason: The page 30 photo crop is owned by the atomic photo-treatment Requirement and does not change the document's general layout or graphic-treatment rules.
Showing the full tree in a page 30 photo does not change the Agua Arc brand identity or required brand assets.
The photo-cropping instruction does not affect proposal table inclusion, replacement, or formatting.
The instruction concerns a photo on page 30, not the cover letter's page count, signature, or image-relocation rule.
A requested photo crop does not change Canva source access, ownership, editability, or asset policy.
The page 30 image treatment has no necessary effect on hyperlink functionality in the saved proposal.
The photo-cropping request neither changes narrative integration nor resolves the Section 6 content ambiguity.
Adjusting a photo crop does not change the final PDF format, file count, export quality, or email-delivery constraints.
The source instruction applies to the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and does not affect the TPEC proposal.
Showing the full tree through recropping does not necessarily change the page-limit goal or the established page-reduction approach.
This individual revision comment does not change the number of revision rounds or the trigger for consolidated final revisions.
The page 30 photo adjustment does not alter any draft, revision, or submission deadline.
